notes:
SUMMARY: StellarBridge is a mid-market fintech platform that runs white-label contact centers for regional banks and fintech apps. They're evaluating Redwood primarily for agent-assist and ticket summarization with strict requirements on provenance and freshness. Key ask: RAG workflow that returns citations with line-level provenance and a quick way to evict stale docs.

Key technical requirements / signals:
- Connectors: Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, Confluence, S3 cold storage. Will also want Kafka-based changefeed for near-real-time document updates.
- Retrieval: multi-source ranking (KB + tickets + product docs) with explicit citation list and per-citation timestamps. Must show why each citation was selected.
- Freshness: legal/regulatory support teams need <24h freshness for regulatory FAQ updates in EU markets. Backfill of ~2M ticket threads for POC but only last 18 months prioritized.
- Latency / scale targets: baseline 8 QPS steady-state supporting ~40 concurrent agents; must tolerate bursts up to 40 QPS (peak business hours) without >95th pct latency spikes. Desired P95 generation latency for short suggestions <350ms; embedding+retrieval P95 <150ms.
- Reliability: graceful degradation required — fallback to cached snippets / simpler reranker when primary model/QPS constrained. Must support routing to cheaper quantized model for non-sensitive contexts and higher-quality model for escalations.
- Tool-calling: ability to surface and execute internal helper tools (lookup account, open ticket, escalate) via function/tool-calling hooks. Audit log required for every tool call.
- Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2 compliance, KMS for envelope encryption, per-tenant retention controls, and EU data residency for a large bank customer.

Customer quotes / paraphrases from calls:
- "We need to show analysts where answers came from — auditors won't accept opaque summaries."
- "If our agents slow down during peak queue spikes we lose SLAs — reliability is a hard requirement."

POC plan (short):
- Week 0: ingest connectors + backfill last 18 months of tickets into staging vector DB
- Week 1: validate retrieval precision, implement citation display and TTL-based freshness rules
- Week 2: run synthetic spike tests (up to 40 QPS) and measure P95/P99 latency; demo tool-calling flows and audit logs

Commercial notes:
- Cost sensitive; prefers reserved capacity if unit economics favorable for steady-state. Wants Redwood's optimize recommendations (batching, quantization) to project ARR impact.

Open questions / asks for Redwood:
- Provide sample DPA and EU data residency options (drive links sent), include KMS/HSM integration notes.
- Example benchmarks vs OpenAI for identical prompts and same vector DB.
- Confirm supported connectors and changefeed latency guarantees.

NEXT STEPS: Start 2-week POC once legal confirms DPA and SE confirms access to a sandbox Zendesk org. AE to schedule POC kickoff for 2026-03-18 (tentative).
